entries.description: Changelog system overhaul — auto-documentation, chronological ordering, content change tracking.
changes: All cron jobs now document changes in content.json changelog
Changelog entries sorted chronologically (oldest first, newest last)
Daily mutations now track content text changes (intro, imageCard, facts)
Git-pull-build adds chore entries when changes are pulled
Duplicate same-day entries are updated instead of duplicated
